name: Circle of Summoning (Druid Circle)
body:
You love nature, and nature loves you.

Bonus Spells: summon nature’s ally I (1st), summon nature’s ally II (2nd), summon nature’s ally III (3rd), summon nature’s ally IV (4th), summon nature’s ally V (5th), summon nature’s ally VI (6th). summon nature’s ally VII (7th), summon nature’s ally VIII (8th). summon nature’s ally IX (9th).

Manifestation: You seem to be unusually healthy and vigorous, at least in appearance.

Granted Powers: You gain the following abilities as part of this circle.

Menagerie (Ex)

At 1st level, you gain Versatile Summon Nature’s Allymsh as a bonus feat, even if you don’t meet the prerequisites.

Swift Summoning (Ex)

At 8th level, you may cast summon nature’s ally as a standard action.

Extended Service (Ex)

At 16th level, whenever you cast summon nature’s ally, the duration lasts until you either cast the spell again, or until you rest and regain spell slots.

Druidic Talents

The following talents are available to legendary druids with this circle:

Connection (Su)

(Minor Talent)

You can communicate telepathically, as if you share a language, with creatures you summon for up to a range of 1 mile.

Diverse Abundance (Ex)

(Minor Talent)

Whenever you cast summon nature’s ally and would summon multiple creatures, the creatures do not need to all be the same species. Instead, you may summon any combination of creatures from the list of creatures available. You may substitute creatures from lower level lists, but the number of creatures you summon does not increase.

Eternal Friendship (Ex)

(Minor Talent)

Whenever you cast a conjuration (summoning) spell, increase the duration by a number of rounds equal to your class level (minimum 1). This increase is not doubled by the Extend Spell metamagic or other similar effects.

Tenacious Summons (Ex)

(Major Talent)

Any creature you summon gains temporary hit points equal to three times your Wisdom modifier and gains the evasion ability, allowing a creature to take no damage after making a successful Reflex saving throw against an effect that deals half damage on a successful save.
